text:
jess-sales: Heads up 10x FinTech wants BYO-KMS POC. Requirements: customer HSM behind their firewall, attestation proof on each release, hourly rotation optional, and clear pricing for egress + ops. Can we confirm feasibility?

 tom-eng: Feasible. Architecture idea: inference host requests ephemeral envelope key from their HSM via our proxy connector in customer VPC. We keep only wrapped keys and a short-lived cache.

 anika-security: Must confirm: (1) we never persist unwrapped key material to disk; (2) mTLS for HSM connections; (3) support for split-key / threshold KMS? Also they want vendor attestation and signed firmware hash with timestamp.

 omar-sre: Perf caveat: per-request HSM roundtrip will add variable latency. If they insist on hourly rotation, caching is useless; hourly -> still many calls on heavy traffic. Need to quantify extra calls per minute.

 jess-sales: They asked if we can do a hybrid: short-lived envelope keys (TTL 1-5m) with forced rotation event when customer rotates master key. They will accept 5m if we document risk.

 nina-solutions: We should produce a short doc that shows tradeoffs: cache TTL vs HSM calls vs burst cost. Also checklist: firewall rules, IP allowlist, cert exchange process, attestation exchange cadence (on deploy + weekly).

 anika-security: Add to checklist: audit log forwarding (syslog or secure webhook), retention 1 year for audit trail, and signed attestation blob stored with reference only (no plaintext). Also require attestation includes HSM vendor, serial, firmware, and generated nonce for freshness.

 tom-eng: Example connection snippet for their infra team:

```
# mutual TLS example
openssl s_client -connect 10.2.3.45:8443 -cert client.crt -key client.key -CAfile ca.pem
```

Note: we only use this for the proxy connector; internal runtime never exposes keys.

 omar-sre: For POC acceptance tests we'll run a canary with load generator. Targets: p95 < 30ms (end-to-end), success rate > 99.5%, rotation/no-leak test (prove master key rotate triggers cache invalidation).

 jess-sales: Pricing: buyer wants committed monthly with line item for HSM egress (api calls) or flat uplift. ops/finance do we have a template?

 contracts-bot: Uploaded: /files/sales/templates/byok-ratecard-template.xlsx

 nina-solutions: Proposed billing: base Dedicated + BYOK add-on ($Xk/month) + per-million egress calls over threshold. We should provide a scenario table: low/medium/high usage with costs.

 anika-security: Legal note: attestation exchange requires language on data minimization. I've flagged contracts for an addendum that disallows storing attestation blobs beyond 90 days unless customer requests otherwise. Also need NDA-approved handling of firmware hashes.

 tom-eng: Implementation item: automatic cache invalidation webhook from our control plane when customer signals rotation. We'll support a signed rotation webhook endpoint.

 jess-sales: Action items: Tom to draft the connector design + sample TLS command; Anika to draft security answers + attestation addendum; Omar to run perf estimate + calls-per-minute calc; Nina to draft cost scenarios; I'll coordinate with buyer on budget and timeline.

 omar-sre: Quick calc: with 1000 TPS inference requests and 1 envelope per request, a 5m cache reduces HSM calls by ~300x. With hourly rotation that drops to ~60x. I'll attach a spreadsheet tomorrow.

 nina-solutions: Buyer also wants an option for certified FIPS HSMs only. We'll add FIPS-certified vendor list and note on limited region availability.

 anika-security: Final blocker: their legal wants cryptographic attestation to include an auditable certificate chain. We need contract team to confirm acceptance criteria for signed attestation certs before we kick POC.

 jess-sales: Ok will escalate to contracts now. POC kickoff planned in 3 business days pending SOW and attestation language.

 tom-eng: I'll have a short runbook and SOW appendix by EOD tomorrow.

 jess-sales: Thanks all, keeping thread pinned to the deal. :white_check_mark:
